The Offer

Check the ‘Just for you’ section in your Chase login to see if you are targeted for one of these increased Chase business card signup bonus offers: 

  • Chase INK Cash (no fee) – get $1,200 back after spending $6,000 within 3 months.
  • Chase INK Unlimited (no fee) – get $1,200 back after spending $6,000 within 3 months.
  • Chase INK Preferred ($95) – get 125,000 points after spending $8,000 within 3 months.
  • Chase Sapphire Reserve for Business ($795) – get 300,000 points after spending $30,000 within 4 months.

In your Chase login, look for the hamburger menu and then Just For You to see if you got these ‘You’re Already Approved’ offers:

Our Verdict

These are all excellent offers and worth jumping on. Just note, ‘Already Approved’ ironically does not mean you’re guaranteed approval, but hopefully it means the odds are good.

  • Standard offer on INK Cash and Unlimited is $750, and we did recently see an increased $1,000 offer. This targeted $1,200 offer is the best ever. 
  • Standard offer on the INK Preferred card is 100,000 points, and we have seen an increased 120,000 offer. This targeted 125,000 offer is the best ever.
  • Standard offer on the Sapphire Reserve for Business card is 150,000, and we do currently have an increased 200,000 offer. This 300,000 offer is the best ever. We already wrote about this offer in a prior post. Just adding the three increased INK offers in this post.

Hat tip to reader Brendan and to ChocolateAndAmbition
